# heic2any

Vendored browser bundle for [heic2any 0.0.4](https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any/tree/0.0.4).
It is loaded lazily when a browser cannot decode an uploaded HEIC or HEIF photo
natively. The bundle converts the photo locally to JPEG; no file is uploaded.

- Bundle: `heic2any-0.0.4.min.js`
- License: MIT, reproduced in `LICENSE.md`

Do not hand-edit the minified bundle.
